name: Casas de Millán (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casas de Millán (a sword and a cross of Saint James above waves) between the words CASAS DE MILLÁN in black.
history: Municipal flag of Casas de Millán; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Casas de Millán arms — sword and cross of Saint James above waves
inscription CASAS DE MILLÁN around the arms
